intro.uz: Bekzod blogida Toshkent metrosi haqida yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz metroda yurganmisiz? Sizga qaysi bekat yoqadi?

paragraphs.en: Hi, I'm Bekzod. I live in Tashkent. Every day I go to college by metro. The metro is fast and cheap. It is not new. The first line is from 1977.
paragraphs.uz: Salom, men Bekzodman. Men Toshkentda yashayman. Har kuni kollejga metroda boraman. Metro tez va arzon. U yangi emas. Birinchi liniya 1977-yilda ochilgan.

paragraphs.en: Today there are many lines. In the morning the trains are very full, so I always stand.
paragraphs.uz: Hozir metroda koʻplab liniyalar bor. Ertalab poyezdlar juda gavjum boʻladi, shuning uchun men doim tik turaman.

paragraphs.en: The stations are very beautiful. My favourite station is Kosmonavtlar. It is blue, and there are pictures of cosmonauts on the walls. Alisher Navoi station is beautiful too.
paragraphs.uz: Bekatlar juda chiroyli. Mening sevimli bekatim — «Kosmonavtlar». U koʻk rangda, devorlarida kosmonavtlarning suratlari bor. «Alisher Navoiy» bekati ham chiroyli.

paragraphs.en: Tips for visitors: buy a ticket at the station. Don't stand near the edge of the platform. And please give your seat to old people!
paragraphs.uz: Mehmonlar uchun maslahatlar: chiptani bekatda sotib oling. Platforma chetiga yaqin turmang. Va iltimos, keksalarga joy bering!
